Knowledge facts: part C holds 42 fact blocks (sec15-F01 onward) from physical pages 110 to 116; part C2 holds 46 confusable and continuation blocks (sec15-R01 onward).
Exam authority: part A states the issuer, the July 1, 2022 content date, the multiple-choice format and its four roughly equal topic areas, the vision standard and the one-day retake wait from physical pages 3, 35 and 36; question count, passing score and time limit are unknown.
VERIFY list:
- TN-SPEC-A-EXAM — question count, passing score and time limit not printed in the manual (owner EvidenceLibrarian, official tier).
- TN-SPEC-A-FRESH — content dated July 1, 2022; current edition and liveness unconfirmed (owner EvidenceLibrarian, official tier).
- TN-SPEC-D-NONABS — non-antilock hard braking: release and reapply versus steady pressure without pumping (owner HallucinationAuditor).
- TN-SPEC-D-BREAKS — rest breaks every hour versus every two hours or about a hundred miles (owner HallucinationAuditor).
- TN-SPEC-D-STAT — yearly crash count is undated (owner EvidenceLibrarian).
- TN-SPEC-MARKET — market pack unresearched (owner SMEResearchAgent).
- TN-SPEC-TEARDOWN — competitive teardown unresearched (owner SMEResearchAgent).
Dynamic facts: the epilepsy seizure-free period, the corrective lens restriction code, the legal tread depth and the dated crash count (for example sec15-F29, sec15-F33, sec15-F36, sec15-R18) can change and must be refreshed from official Tennessee sources.
